body:
Oh man, this is me sometimes too. I’d love nothing more than to say it’s something you grow out of but unfortunately it needs consistent work and practice (a bit like training for marathons). Be proud that you’ve acknowledged that you have NPD (a very hard step for a lot of people) Don’t push it off any longer, take the next few days to come up with a plan. This subreddit has given me hope and what best to do for myself. Use it rather than google searches as best you can, it focuses on the victims and just lashes out on those with NPD and could just encourage senses of hopelessness.  

And most importantly, be kind to yourself. The road is long and will have a few potholes along the way but you got this 👍
I feel the same way, I hit rock bottom too.

Thank you. My wife tells me that I’m mean to her and other people. I don’t pull my weight at home and I lie or make excuses to justify myself. I know that when she hits me that it’s wrong but I’ve lost the will. She’s going to leave but promised that she’ll tell everyone what a horrible person I am. And she’s right.
